mainCharacter.name: Nora
mainCharacter.description: An energetic four-year-old South Asian girl with warm medium-brown skin, large dark-brown eyes, a round face, and black wavy hair in two low puff ponytails; she wears a teal rain jacket over a clay-red shirt, ochre shorts, navy rain boots, and a small cream cross-body notebook pouch.
identityInvariants: four-year-old child proportions with a round face
warm medium-brown skin and large dark-brown eyes
black wavy hair in two low puff ponytails with teal ties
teal rain jacket over clay-red shirt
ochre shorts and navy rain boots
cream cross-body notebook pouch; no glasses or hat

signatureProps: Nora's palm-sized cream notebook with exactly four large outlined boxes on each active page, held by Nora unless explicitly shared for viewing
short moss-green pencil attached to notebook by a cream cord
Jo's tiny lake-blue backpack with one round clay-red patch
locations: home entry at left opens to a garden path traveling consistently left-to-right past a blue watering can, three flower beds, and a low wooden sparrow fence
the same garden path curves downhill into the creek path; the blue watering can remains behind and a forked birch marks the curve
creek path runs left-to-right with wet stone at near edge, fallen log just beyond it, ant crack in path farther right, creek always on upper/far side
home window faces the garden; low sill places both children at butterfly-view height and the garden path runs beyond it
avoid: random clutter or hidden focal point
extra notebook boxes or premature marks
accidental text, letters, logos, or watermark
